info.name: NEMBUS API
info.description: NEMBUS Backend API & Local Biometric Hardware Bridge. All routes from routing + JWT/Tenant middleware. Use x-tenant-id and Bearer token. Select NEMBUS Local environment.

request.description: Authenticates using an ISO/IEC 19794-2:2005 probe FMD captured from the fingerprint reader. Omit `user_login` for 1:N touch-only identification across active enrolled users.

Authenticates a supervisor and returns a short-lived authorization token (5-min TTL) scoped to the given permission_code. The POS uses this token in the X-Authorization-Token header when calling a restricted endpoint (e.g. POST /api/pos/returns).

The test script below auto-saves the token to the `authorization_token` environment/collection variable so the POS Returns request can use it immediately.

exec: console.error("❌ No authorization_token in response", JSON.stringify(res));

item.name: Authorize Action with Biometric (Supervisor Fingerprint Override)

request.description: Identifies a supervisor by fingerprint (1:1 if `supervisor_login` provided, else 1:N across active enrolled users) and mints a 5-minute `X-Authorization-Token` when the matched user holds `permission_code`. Auto-saves `authorization_token` to environment/collection variables.

exec: console.log("✅ Biometric authorization_token saved:", res.data.permission_code, "expires:", res.data.expires_at);
console.error("❌ No authorization_token in response", JSON.stringify(res));

request.description: Checks whether a physical DigitalPersona U.are.U fingerprint reader is connected and ready on `http://127.0.0.1:5050/api/v1/device`.
Returns metadata about the connected fingerprint reader (device name, vendor/product name, serial number, resolution DPI).

Blocks until a finger is placed on the scanner, captures the image, checks NFIQ quality, extracts an ISO/IEC 19794-2:2005 FMD template, and auto-saves `fmd_base64` to the Postman environment/collection variable.

exec: const fmd = (res && res.fmd_base64) || (res && res.data && res.data.fmd_base64) || (res && res.fmd);
console.log("✅ Captured fmd_base64 saved to variable");

request.description: Cancels an in-progress blocking fingerprint capture session.

item.name: Multi-Sample Enrollment Capture (4 Scans -> Consolidated FMD)

request.description: Captures `count` (default 4) sequential scans of the same finger, automatically rejecting poor NFIQ scans (>= 4), consolidates them into an ISO/IEC 19794-2:2005 enrollment FMD, and auto-saves `consolidated_fmd` into `{{fmd_base64}}` for immediate use in `POST /api/users/{{user_id}}/biometrics/enroll`.

exec: const fmd = (res && res.consolidated_fmd) || (res && res.data && res.data.consolidated_fmd) || (res && res.fmd);
console.log("✅ Consolidated enrollment fmd_base64 saved to variable");

request.description: Cancels an active enrollment capture session and clears collected views.
Resets the embedded bridge enrollment state machine for a 4-scan interactive enrollment.
Captures one scan step for the interactive enrollment session. Call 4 times; on step 4 (`needs_more_data: false`), `consolidated_fmd` is returned and auto-saved to `{{fmd_base64}}`.

exec: console.log("✅ Step 4 complete: consolidated_fmd saved to fmd_base64");

request.description: Returns active enrolled finger indices (1-10) and metadata for a user without exposing raw FMD bytes.

item.name: Enroll User Fingerprint (by User Path ID)

request.description:
Stores a consolidated ISO/IEC 19794-2:2005 FMD after an organization-wide 1:N duplicate check. Requires `users:enroll` permission or an `X-Authorization-Token` scoped to `users:enroll`.

**NIST `finger_index` values:**
- `1`–`5`: Right Thumb (1), Right Index (2), Right Middle (3), Right Ring (4), Right Little (5)
- `6`–`10`: Left Thumb (6), Left Index (7), Left Middle (8), Left Ring (9), Left Little (10)
Same enrollment endpoint without `:id` in the URL path (`user_id` is read from the JSON body). You may also pass `view_fmds_base64: ["..."]` to have the backend consolidate raw scan views.
Soft-deactivates (`is_active = false`) the specified finger template (`fingerIndex` 1–10) for sync propagation. Requires `users:enroll` permission.

Process a sales return. Requires a valid supervisor authorization token in X-Authorization-Token header.

**Flow:**
1. Run `Authorize Action (Supervisor Override)` or `Authorize Action with Biometric` first — the test script will auto-save the token.
2. Run this request — the `{{authorization_token}}` variable is used automatically.

The `authorized_by_user_id` of the approving supervisor is stored in the return metadata for audit.
